name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Vera, Caro-Kann, Fork, and Scholar's belong to different players.
Damiano's goes with at most one of Anatoly, London, Zwischenzug, and Maple.
Caro-Kann goes with neither Pin nor Rosewood.
Back-rank goes with exactly one of Vera, Ebony, or Maple.
Anatoly goes with exactly two of Caro-Kann, Fork, and Anastasia's.
Judit goes with none of French, Pin, or Anastasia's.
Vera goes with either Fork or Zwischenzug.
Fork goes with at least one of Nadia, Caro-Kann, or Pirc.
Vera goes with exactly two of Caro-Kann, Glass, and Damiano's.
